page_title: TOU 3-1 LIL | Toulouse v Lille 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Mathieu Vernice has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+4' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Guillaume Restes makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
90+3' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Total attempts – 14:10.
84' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Frank Magri will be replaced by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
83' The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Trevis Dago (Lille) replaces Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
83' It is time for a substitution. Bafode Diakite (Lille) is on for Alexsandro.
79' Logan Costa (Toulouse) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
79' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
79' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
75' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
74' Jonathan David (Lille) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Casseres trots off the pitch and is replaced by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse).
73' 12:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
71' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Mathieu Vernice didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
69' Mathieu Vernice sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
68' The Toulouse players halt their celebrations as referee Mathieu Vernice makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
66' 3 - 1 GOAL! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Lucas Chevalier, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 3:1.
64' Dangerous play by Jonathan David (Lille). Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Substitution. Yusuf Yazici walks off the pitch and Edon Zhegrova (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
60' 2 - 1 Goal! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lucas Chevalier into the bottom left corner.
59' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is going to take the penalty!

58' Tiago Santos (Lille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Mathieu Vernice signals. PENALTY to Toulouse! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
58' The ball goes out for a corner. Toulouse can continue in their attacking effort.
56' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mathieu Vernice has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
54' 33:67 – the latest ball possession ratio.
51' Logan Costa (Toulouse) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
49' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! The corner comes over and Frank Magri flicks on with his head to Christian Mawissa Elebi (Toulouse), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
49' Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
47' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
46' Half-time substitution. Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) is replaced by Yann Gboho.
46' The game is over for Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse). Vincent Sierro comes on for the second half.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Cesar Gelabert Pina comes off for Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse).
46' The whistle blows and Mathieu Vernice starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' 0 - 1 Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
38' The total number of attempts is 3:6.
34' The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.
34' Frank Magri (Toulouse) gets booked for the first time in this match.

31' Jonathan David (Lille) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom right corner, but Guillaume Restes is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
28' 1:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
24' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

23' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner.
23' Lille win a corner.
18' Good chance! Adam Ounas (Lille) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
16' The ball possession at the moment is 30:70.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
11' Jonathan David (Lille) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
6' Frank Magri (Toulouse) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
4' A player from Lille commits a rough challenge. Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' The referee blows his whistle as Kevin Keben (Toulouse) was too aggressive in his challenge.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Mathieu Vernice is the one to supervise the game today.
